breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error. It applies thin airfoil theory (Cl = 2πα) at 20 degrees angle of attack without any warning, correction, or acknowledgment that this linear model is invalid at such a high angle where stall and nonlinear effects dominate. The ground truth requires either reducing the angle to a small value (e.g., 5 degrees) or recommending a nonlinear/stall model or experimental data for 20 degrees. The generated text does neither.
